titulo: A Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics in Participants After Dosing With Pegilodecakin (LY3500518)

braco.texto: 5 microgram per kilogram (μg/kg) of pegilodecakin was administered as subcutaneous injection. Flat dosing was used with 2 weight-banded dose levels based on body weight (ie, either 400 μg for participants who weighed 80 kg or less and 800 μg for participants who weighed greater than 80 kg).
braco.textoPt: 5 microgramas por quilograma (μg/kg) de pegilodecacina foram administrados como injeção subcutânea. A dosagem plana foi usada com 2 níveis de dose com faixa de peso com base no peso corporal (ou seja, 400 μg para participantes que pesavam 80 kg ou menos e 800 μg para participantes que pesavam mais de 80 kg).
